events.title: Backpack introduces tokenized SpaceX
events.description: Backpack announced SPCX as a self-custodied tokenized security on Solana with 1:1 redemption through Backpack Securities.
events.limitation: The announcement date is context, not proof that it caused subsequent trading or ownership changes.

events.title: Backpack introduces tokenized Micron
events.description: Backpack announced MU as its second tokenized security under the redeemable securities framework.
events.limitation: The announcement date is context, not proof that it caused subsequent trading or ownership changes.

events.title: Backpack announces 24/7 market for selected equities
events.description: Backpack announced continuous trading for selected equities and named SPCX, MU and SNDK among the first products.
events.limitation: This is an issuer press release. Product availability does not establish user adoption.

external_observations.methodology: Reported change in DEX trading volume for Backpack-issued tokenized stocks versus the immediately preceding seven-day period.
external_observations.limitation: This is a week-over-week change, not total seven-day volume. Exact window dates, underlying totals and reproducible query details were not published in the post.
